title: Diaryl terephthalamides as small-molecule disruptors of the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX protein-protein interaction: Mechanistic insights and biochemical validation.
authors: Alfassam, Haifa E; Kamel, Emadeldin M; Othman, Sarah I; Alharbi, Hanan M; Allam, Ahmed A; Rudayni, Hassan A; Lamsabhi, Al Mokhtar
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选、分子对接、MD模拟和MM/PBSA等方法研究小分子破坏c-Myb转录因子与CBP/p300 KIX域的蛋白-蛋白互作，虽非直接建模TF-DNA结合，但涉及转录因子互作界面机制且方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究。
abstract: The interaction between the transcription factor c-Myb and the CBP/p300 KIX domain is a functionally important protein-protein interface that supports oncogenic transcriptional programs in acute myeloid leukemia and therefore represents an attractive target for inhibitor discovery. Herein, we investigated diaryl terephthalamides as a new small-molecule chemotype for disruption of the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX interaction by integrating computational screening with experimental validation. A virtual-screening workflow was applied to a library diaryl terephthalamide derivatives affording five hit compounds (C1-C5). Docking and simulation results showed that C1 and C4 most consistently occupied the c-Myb-facing groove, whereas C5 adopted a distinct but still stable KIX-associated binding mode. Protein-protein interaction metrics calculations indicated that all five compounds weakened the c-Myb-KIX interface to varying extents, with C4 showing the strongest predicted disruptive effect and the most favorable ligand binding free energy, while C5 also exhibited substantial activity. MM/PBSA-based protein-protein interaction perturbation analysis further showed that all five compounds produced positive DeltaDeltaG(PPI) values, consistent with weakening of the c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX interface, with C4 and C5 showing the largest predicted disruptive effects (+25.85 and + 18.27 kcal/mol, respectively). Free-energy landscape analysis further supported stable low-energy binding states for C1 and C4, whereas C3 showed greater conformational heterogeneity. In silico ADMET profiling suggested that the series satisfies basic drug-likeness criteria but still carries notable developability liabilities requiring future optimization. Experimental microscale thermophoresis confirmed direct disruption of the Myb-KIX interaction, with C4 and C5 showing the best inhibitory potency, yielding IC(50) values of 27.72 +/- 7.80 and 27.11 +/- 7.45 muM, respectively, compared with 34.74 +/- 12.93 muM for Naphthol AS-E phosphate. Consistent with these biochemical findings, C4 and C5 showed the strongest reduction in AML cell viability in HL-60 and THP-1 cells. Overall, these findings identify diaryl terephthalamides as promising c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX disruptors and establish C4 and C5 as the most compelling leads for further medicinal-chemistry development.
abstract_zh: 转录因子c-Myb与CBP/p300 KIX结构域之间的相互作用是一个功能上重要的蛋白质-蛋白质界面，支持急性髓系白血病中的致癌转录程序，因此代表了抑制剂发现的吸引人靶点。在此，我们通过整合计算筛选与实验验证，研究了二芳基对苯二甲酰胺作为破坏c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX相互作用的新型小分子化学型。将虚拟筛选工作流程应用于二芳基对苯二甲酰胺衍生物库，获得了五个命中化合物（C1-C5）。对接和模拟结果表明，C1和C4最一致地占据c-Myb朝向的沟槽，而C5采用了不同但稳定的KIX相关结合模式。蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用指标计算表明，所有五种化合物在不同程度上削弱了c-Myb-KIX界面，其中C4显示出最强的预测破坏效应和最有利的配体结合自由能，而C5也表现出显著活性。基于MM/PBSA的蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用扰动分析进一步显示，所有五种化合物均产生正的DeltaDeltaG(PPI)值，与c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX界面的削弱一致，其中C4和C5显示出最大的预测破坏效应（分别为+25.85和+18.27 kcal/mol）。自由能景观分析进一步支持C1和C4的稳定低能结合状态，而C3显示出更大的构象异质性。计算机ADMET分析表明，该系列满足基本药物相似性标准，但仍带有显著的开发性缺陷，需要未来优化。实验性微量热泳动证实了Myb-KIX相互作用的直接破坏，其中C4和C5显示出最佳抑制效力，IC(50)值分别为27.72 +/- 7.80和27.11 +/- 7.45 muM，而Naphthol AS-E磷酸盐为34.74 +/- 12.93 muM。与这些生化发现一致，C4和C5在HL-60和THP-1细胞中显示出最强的AML细胞活力降低。总体而言，这些发现将二芳基对苯二甲酰胺确定为有前景的c-Myb-CBP/p300 KIX破坏剂，并将C4和C5确立为进一步药物化学开发的最有说服力的先导化合物。
